strategies.text:
Overview

Mega Falinks is another goofy looking mega debut. The new mega form is a little bit tanky but ultimately a cruise solo with the right counters.

Est Time to Win: 180.0s - 230.0s


Main Strategy

Use a single Mega Rayquaza or Mega Mewtwo Y to DPS Mega Falinks. Mega Mewtwo Y is comfortable running psycho cut or confusion, either is fine. It is advised to be careful with mega Mewtwo Y because Mega Falinks does learn the super effective Megahorn which can outspeed Psystrike. Pre-dodging may be recommended at certain times. Make sure to cleanly exit the raid without wasting energy and rejoin the fight after healing.


A shadow mewtwo may be added if Megahorn forces too many rejoins.

battleParties.label: Mega Rayquaza or Mega Mewtwo Y
